tasks.title: Choose the next deployment step
tasks.when_to_use: A developer asks where to deploy a change or proposes a first production release.
tasks.avoid: Treating a successful build as proof that a change was verified outside production.
tasks.example_request: Recommend my next deployment step and explain why.
tasks.example_behavior: Use the configured default unless the developer makes a valid explicit choice. Ask about missing requirements before recommending a restricted choice.

choices.recommendation: Try the change in an isolated preview environment.
choices.rationale: A preview lets you inspect the change before exposing it to users.

choices.recommendation: Try the change in your team's staging environment.
choices.rationale: Staging provides a shared nonproduction place to check integration behavior.

choices.recommendation: Consider production next, following your team's release requirements.
choices.rationale: The developer explicitly selected production and confirmed nonproduction verification; this tool does not independently validate that claim.

fact_questions.verified_nonproduction: Has this change been verified in a nonproduction environment?
